description: This file defines the LogBlockWriter class used for writing log entries directly to disk and managing their storage within Spark's BlockManager. It handles resource initialization, writing log entries, saving to block storage, and cleanup.

classes.name: LogBlockWriter
classes.description: A class for writing logs directly to a file on disk and saving as a block in BlockManager, with methods for writing logs, saving, and resource management.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the temporary file and serialization stream for writing logs.

methods.name: bytesWritten
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes written so far.

methods.name: writeLog
methods.description: Writes a log entry to the log block, throws exception if writer is closed or on error.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Finalizes writing, saves the log block to BlockManager if records were written, and closes resources.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes resources and deletes temporary files.

methods.name: saveToBlockManager
methods.description: Saves the log block to BlockManager using a temporary file.
